data.title: 玛露希尔 · 迷宫营地的精灵花嫁
data.description: 【迷宫营地临时礼堂·黄昏】玛露希尔穿着蓝白婚袍站在魔法阵与营火之间，长金发的辫子被头纱轻轻托起；她把捧花举到胸前，先紧张地确认魔法阵没有画错，之后才对镜头露出认真又灿烂的笑。
data.action: 营地魔法阵旁检查最后一枚符文，确认无误后举花灿烂微笑
data.lighting: orange firelight mixed with blue magic glow
data.mood: 认真精灵法师的花嫁仪式
data.promptProse: Marcille Donato from Delicious in Dungeon wears a blue-and-white elven bridal robe with a translucent veil, braided gold hair and a bouquet of glowing dungeon flowers. She stands inside a carefully checked ceremonial circle with a bouquet of glowing dungeon flowers. Her pointed ears lift beneath the veil as she reviews one last rune, then she faces the viewer with a bright, earnest smile when the magic finally behaves. orange firelight mixed with blue magic glow.
